messages:
anna.devex: quick sanity check — our go streaming client (internal sdk v0.39) started throwing 401s on reconnect after we switched to impersonating a project-bound service account. only happens when the original request was to the tenant-scoped audience. anyone seen aud change during reauth?

raj.sre: saw something similar last month with k8s node creds + impersonation. token refresh returns an aud that matches the impersonation target, not the original tenant. leads to aud mismatch on the server side.

mike-sdk: yup — SDK currently reuses the original request target for reconnect, but the refreshed JWT from our impersonation helper sets aud="https://auth.redwood-inference.internal/impersonate/PROJECT" instead of the API-audience. server rejects.

sophie-ml: is this only for JWT-based impersonation or also for OIDC tokens?

raj.sre: mostly JWT flow, but OIDC id_tokens can vary too depending on the STS exchange. TL;DR: audience can mutate if you swap identity.

anna.devex: possible mitigation: add AudienceHint to the reconnect flow and prefer the downstream endpoint aud? anyone opposed if I open a tiny PR to set audHint = originalAudience when doing reauth + impersonation?

mike-sdk: sounds reasonable. we should be explicit: when calling sts:token for impersonation, pass \"requested_token_audience\" = originalAudience. i can drop a patch in go and ts SDKs.

sophie-ml: can you paste the quick patch pattern? easier for us to test.

mike-sdk: sure — example we used in patch notes:```go
// before reconnect
req := sts.TokenRequest{
  SubjectToken: currentJWT,
  TokenType: "urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:access_token",
  RequestedTokenAudience: originalAudience,
}
resp, _ := stsClient.Exchange(ctx, req)
// use resp.AccessToken for reconnect
```

mike-sdk: and TS shim:```ts
await stsClient.exchange({
  subject_token: jwt,
  requested_token_audience: originalAudience,
  token_type: 'urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:access_token'
})
```

anna.devex: nice. can auth-bot replay the logs for my prod run? it shows the reconnect token aud vs expected aud.

auth-bot: replay attached logs for trace id 3f4a2 — originalAud="https://api.redwood/v1" refreshedAud="https://auth.redwood-inference.internal/impersonate/PRJ-123" — server returned 401 on next chunk.

raj.sre: sounds like a plan. two follow-ups: 1) add test that simulates SA impersonation + reconnect in the streaming e2e harness, 2) ensure the SDK surfaces a debug flag so ops can log requested vs returned aud on auth handoffs.

mike-sdk: I'll open the PR with both go+ts patches + an e2e test. tagging @sophie-ml for validation of regression on our streaming workload.

sophie-ml: will run validation tomorrow. also double-check KMS/HSM signers — some of those flows didn't accept requested_token_audience historically. will note in test matrix.

anna.devex: thanks everyone. Mike — ping here when PR is up and I'll coordinate a canary run on dedicated infra. :thumbsup:
